facts.fact: Synergy International Systems says the Judiciary of Zambia is developing, with Treasury funding, an Electronic Case Management System to connect the Supreme, Constitutional, Appeal, High and Subordinate Courts, and that it currently relies on manual processes.

systems.tiers: Supreme, Constitutional, Appeal, High and Subordinate Courts

facts.fact: The Judiciary of Zambia's 2022 annual report says operationalisation of its case management system remained in limbo because funds for customising the software were unavailable, with registries brimming with paper.
The Judiciary's 2022 annual report says it continued uploading decisions of the superior courts, cause lists, notices and press statements to its website.

systems.system: HP Records Manager (Electronic Record Management System)

facts.fact: Chief Justice Mumba Malila opened a Training of Trainers workshop for the Judiciary's Electronic Case Management System, which is to replace paper-based court administration and offer electronic filing and real-time case tracking.

systems.platform: case management with e-filing and tracking

facts.fact: The Times of Zambia reports the Judiciary has launched its nationwide Electronic Case Management System, with the initial rollout a pilot phase in four registries at the Lusaka High Court and Kitwe High Court buildings.

note: 24-hour e-filing is described as what the guidelines provide for, in a pilot still beginning, so no online-filing fact is recorded.
